theme: An open Saturday with travel logistics waiting.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — the calendar's clear today, but a run of travel bookings has gone overdue and tomorrow opens early with the Sunday review.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review prep with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9 AM you and Mike run the 15-minute board sweep. A quick skim of the Dan & Mike board tonight keeps anything from slipping a fourth Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete drive window (Oct 5-18) opens Monday. It's a two-day, two-driver run that still needs the hotel night booked.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the thinnest rental of the year and has been overdue since Sep 14. Holding one now costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist decision slipped past Sep 30. With passports landing in November, a domestic shortlist is the safe default unless you go international on refundable bookings.

flagged.title: Apple: new sign-in on your iPhone
flagged.detail: Apple says a new account signed into your iPhone 17e and asks you to sign in to keep AppleCare One coverage. Worth verifying straight from Settings rather than the email.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Hans-Kristian
flagged.detail: Hans-Kristian messaged you on LinkedIn and it's still awaiting a reply.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto panel bio
flagged.detail: Drew sent back notes on your bio and the LinkedIn announcement for the ICGN panel you're moderating. The draft is yours to finalize.

flagged.title: Valoris Catalysts call
flagged.detail: A Teams meeting went out for you, Martin, Davit and Mike. Confirm whether a time has been pinned.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts and shipping notices: a real-estate alert, Google Play and Apple receipts, an Evite RSVP, and your American Sailing seal on its way.

recipe.title: Roast chicken smothered with chanterelles
recipe.why: Chanterelles are at their autumn peak, and a slow roast is exactly the comfort the season calls for.

acts.line: A clear morning, with nothing on the calendar until tomorrow.
No commitments all afternoon, a rare open stretch to use on something that's been waiting.
An easy evening at home before an early Sunday start.
